data.heading: What Kampala Gentlemen Say

testimonials.name: Denis M.
testimonials.text: Kigozi gives me the sharpest skin fade in Kampala — I have sat in the same chair every two weeks for two years. The hot towel finish after a long week is unmatched.

testimonials.name: Kenneth O.
testimonials.text: Best student price around, and they never rush you. The clippers are always clean and the barbers actually listen to how you want your lineup.

testimonials.name: Ronnie T.
testimonials.text: Brought my four groomsmen here on the wedding morning. Private lounge, everyone looking sharp, photos on point. It set the tone for the whole day.
